summary: Watch the authenticated pages I choose, detect meaningful changes, and leave me a concise, sourced briefing with suggested next steps—without sending or submitting anything.
note: Kept open with the gaps named (note first written 2026-08-07). Covered today: per-page watching with change-only reporting and cited before/after evidence (local-agent/pageWatch.js, cap-c18a0fce); nothing anywhere submits a form, so the "without sending or submitting anything" clause holds structurally — pageWatch and originFanOut are both handed read-only allow-sets that make click and type unreachable rather than merely unused. NEW 2026-08-07: local-agent/originFanOut.js readOrigins() (POST /origins/read): several authenticated origins read for one question, per-origin results with provenance, evidence age and partial success, so "the authenticated pages I choose" is one call. MISSING: (1) the briefing is not sourced from either — local-agent/briefing.js has no browser kind, so a "concise, sourced briefing" over watched pages has no composer; (2) no suggested next steps from a change — browserInspect.proposeAction proposes for one inspected page and is not reachable from a watch report; (3) "meaningful" is literal string inequality in pageWatch.diffValues, with no significance threshold.
